The remaining work is Miyuki's Troubleshooting second pass, which is open for review, and her Virtualization audit. Tomorrow's midweek ship check is the natural moment to review and merge both, so the course is finished and stable while you are at sea.

tip.title: Put your phone in airplane mode once the ship leaves Tampa
tip.body: Ships at sea connect phones to an onboard cellular network that bills as international roaming, and background app refresh alone can run up a surprising charge. Switch to airplane mode with Wi-Fi on as you sail away, and use the ship's Wi-Fi or the Carnival app instead. It is worth a quick look at your carrier's cruise roaming terms before Saturday.

surprise.title: Cozumel means "the island of swallows"
surprise.body: Your one shore day is Tuesday, November 3, when the ship is scheduled in Cozumel from about 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. The name comes from the Maya "Cuzamil," the island of swallows, which is why a swallow sits on the island's flag today. From about 1250 CE, Maya merchants and pilgrims sailed there to honor Ixchel, a goddess of the moon, childbirth, and weaving. The reefs around the island belong to the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef, the second largest reef system in the world at over 620 miles long, and they shelter more than 1,000 marine species. That is why Cozumel is counted among the best scuba-diving spots anywhere. Four days to sailing.
